_note: Trade nodes, like EU4. Each province belongs to one node (trade_node in provinces.json). Value made in a node flows downstream unless collected. A nation collects in its home node (the node of its capital) and wherever it sends a merchant to collect; elsewhere a merchant steers value downstream (+10%). The node seats are the stars on the lore map.

Arcadian Sea.text: The end node: all trade in Arcadia flows here, past Mentos.

Midrea.text: Tech and ore out of the Midrean hills.

Eurome.text: Grain and wine from the farms.

Western Archipelago.text: Ore, gems and salt from the mines.

Southern Sea.text: Pearls and fish from the Southern Isles.

Skyfall.text: Core Energy and holy relics, down the Holy Waterfall.
